data.content:
Kairat are now led by caretaker coach Zhora Arutyunyan after Rafael Urazbakhtin stepped down in late October. Jorginho remains sidelined with a long-term knee injury, while Arutyunyan has leaned towards the 5-3-2 shape used at Atalanta.

Kairat Almaty expected 5-3-2:

Goalkeeper: Temirlan Anarbekov

Defenders: Aleksandr Mrynskiy, Aleksandr Shirobokov, Aleksandr Martynovich, Damir Kasabulat, Luís Mata

Midfielders: Azamat Tuyakbaev, Gustavo Pinto Mendonça, Jaakko Oksanen [...] Goalkeeper: Alexander Lundin

Defenders: Villiam Granath, Tony Miettinen, Axel Norén, Abdullah Iqbal, Max Nielsen

Midfielders: Jesper Gustavsson, Viktor Gustafson, Romeo Arrhenius Leandersson

Attackers: Jeppe Kjær, Áki Samuelsen

Bergström’s availability is the main variable, but Mjällby still have enough runners around Kjær to keep their compact, transition-heavy plan intact. [...] Mjällby have avoided defeat in 8 of their last 10 in all competitions and have drawn 5 of the last 10. However, their broader away sample warns of volatility: winless in 14 of their last 15 away in all competitions, with 9 draws in their last 18 away and 6 defeats in their last 12 away. The current League Stage form suggests that baseline is improving.
